rows.grounds: instrumental of compound nara-yāna indicating means of travel
compound qualifier describing the goddess as remover of all impediments

items.question: By what means or to which deity is protection sought against all obstacles?
premises: A human vehicle is named as one possible means.
The goddess is characterized as the destroyer of all obstacles.
An alternative is presented between these means of seeking protection.
items.inference: Protection from obstacles may be sought by traveling in a human vehicle or by invoking the goddess who destroys all obstacles.
uncertainties: The governing verb is implicit from the preceding verses and not expressed in this verse.
items.plain_english: Whether by a human vehicle or by invoking the goddess who destroys all obstacles.
